# Warehouse Aisle & Shelf Location Tag Template

## Industrial Warehouse Bin Location Tag

High-visibility shelf tags for pick-and-pack inventory management.

### Template Architecture
```html
<div class="bin-tag" style="width: 98mm; height: 28mm; background: #ffff00; color: #000; border: 2px solid #000; padding: 2mm; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;">
  <div>
    <div style="font-size: 8pt; font-weight: bold; letter-spacing: 1px;">ZONE A - AISLE 04</div>
    <div style="font-size: 20pt; font-weight: 900; font-family: monospace;">A04-S2-B12</div>
  </div>
  <div style="width: 24mm; height: 24mm; background: #fff; padding: 1mm;">
    <!-- QR Code Container -->
  </div>
</div>
```
Recommended SKU: **ST-20 A4100** (20 labels/sheet).
